# Study A summary (generated by scripts/panel_study_a.py)

Observed NCEI TMAX only. May-Sep. Hedges fitted on FIT 2015-2019. Intervals: year-block bootstrap, 1,000 draws, seed 473, 95% percentile.
REPORT and SELECT hold three summers each, so a bootstrap draw can take only 10 distinct year mixes. Read the intervals as rough.
mean_R = unweighted mean over locations. miss_rate and false_payout_rate are pooled over locations.
